textes.Bienvenue au festival des Hautes Herbes,: Welcome to the Hautes Herbes festival, three days of open-air music. Stages, artists, concerts, festivalgoers, tickets, volunteers and weather: the whole 2025 edition is here. You help its team: Apolline, the director, Éliott, the programmer, Lucile at the box office, Moussa with the volunteers and Iris, the production manager. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par scène du festival : son no: One row per festival stage: its name, its type and its capacity.
textes.Une ligne par artiste ou groupe programm: One row per artist or band booked for the 2025 edition: their stage name, their music genre, their country and their fee. An artist can play several concerts.
textes.Une ligne par concert, du 4 au 6 juillet: One row per concert, from July 4 to 6, 2025: the artist, the stage, the day, the start and end times, its status and its audience.
textes.Une ligne par festivalier inscrit sur la: One row per festivalgoer signed up on the online box office, whether or not they bought a ticket: first name, last name, email, city and date of birth.
textes.Une ligne par billet acheté en ligne : s: One row per ticket bought online: its holder, its pass type, the day chosen for a 1-day pass, its price and its purchase date. A festivalgoer can have several tickets; those from partner resellers aren’t in it.
textes.Une ligne par passage d’un billet aux po: One row per time a ticket goes through the festival gates: the ticket scanned, the day, the time and the gate. A festivalgoer who leaves and comes back is scanned a second time; a ticket may have no entries.
textes.Une ligne par bénévole inscrit à l’éditi: One row per volunteer signed up for the 2025 edition: first name, last name, role, the year of their first edition and their team lead.
textes.Une ligne par créneau de travail d’un bé: One row per volunteer work shift, from setup on July 3 to teardown on July 7, 2025: the day and the start and end times. A volunteer can have several shifts, or none.
textes.Une ligne par jour, du montage du 3 juil: One row per day, from setup on July 3 to teardown on July 7, 2025: the maximum temperature, the rain that fell, the strongest wind gust and the state of the sky.
textes.Nom de la scène : « Grande Scène », « Sc: Name of the stage: “Main Stage”, “Willow Stage”, “The Big Top” or “The Clearing”.
textes.Type de scène : « Plein air » ou « Couve: Stage type: “Open-air” or “Covered” (under a big top).
textes.Nombre maximal de spectateurs que la scè: Maximum number of people the stage can hold.
textes.Nom de scène de l’artiste ou du groupe (: Stage name of the artist or band (e.g. “Orage Mécanique”).
textes.Pays d’origine de l’artiste, en français: Artist’s country of origin, in English (e.g. “France”, “Belgium”, “United Kingdom”).
textes.Cachet de l’artiste pour toute l’édition: Artist’s fee for the whole edition, in euros, whatever their number of concerts; empty (NULL) if it isn’t set yet, which only happens to artists whose concert was cancelled: their contract is being renegotiated.
The stage where the concert takes place.
textes.Heure de fin, au format HH:MM, toujours: End time, in HH:MM format, always the same day, before midnight.
textes.Nombre de spectateurs estimé par la régi: Audience estimated by the production team at the concert’s peak; empty (NULL) for a cancelled concert.
textes.Adresse e-mail, unique pour chaque festi: Email address, unique for each festivalgoer (e.g. “camille.roussel@mail.fr”).
textes.Le festivalier titulaire du billet, dont: The festivalgoer who holds the ticket, whose name is printed on it.
textes.Formule du billet : « Pass 1 jour » ou «: Ticket pass type: “1-day pass” or “3-day pass”.
textes.Pour un « Pass 1 jour », le seul jour où: For a “1-day pass”, the only day it’s valid (YYYY-MM-DD); empty (NULL) for a “3-day pass”, valid all three days.
The ticket scanned at the gate.
textes.Heure du passage, au format HH:MM (ex. «: Time of the entry, in HH:MM format (e.g. “18:05”).
textes.Poste du bénévole pendant tout le festiv: Volunteer’s role for the whole festival: “Bar”, “Cleaning”, “Security” or “Welcome desk”.
textes.Année de sa première édition comme bénév: Year of their first edition as a volunteer, from 2018 (the festival’s very first edition) to 2025.
textes.Le bénévole responsable de son équipe, d: The volunteer leading their team, in the same role; empty (NULL) for a team lead.
Unique ID of the time slot.
textes.Le bénévole qui assure le créneau, à son: The volunteer working the shift, in their role.
textes.Jour du créneau (AAAA-MM-JJ), du « 2025-: Day of the shift (YYYY-MM-DD), from “2025-07-03” (setup) to “2025-07-07” (teardown).
textes.Heure de fin, au format HH:MM, toujours: End time, in HH:MM format, always the same day.
textes.Jour du relevé (AAAA-MM-JJ) ; un seul re: Day of the reading (YYYY-MM-DD); only one reading per day.
textes.Température maximale de la journée, en d: Maximum temperature of the day, in degrees Celsius.
textes.Pluie tombée dans la journée, en millimè: Rain that fell during the day, in millimeters; 0 if it didn’t rain.
textes.Rafale de vent la plus forte de la journ: Strongest wind gust of the day, in km/h.
textes.Quels artistes n’ont pas encore de cache: Which artists don’t have a fee set yet?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival that lasted three days, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each booked artist gets a fee, the amount paid to come and play; when it isn’t set yet, the cell stays empty. After the cancelled concerts of the 2025 edition, some contracts are being renegotiated. Éliott, the programmer, who picks the artists and negotiates their fees, wants to follow up with the agents of the artists whose fee still isn’t set.
textes.les artistes dont le cachet est vide (NU: the artists whose fee is empty (NULL)
textes.Un cachet pas encore fixé se reconnaît à: A fee not set yet is one with an empty cell. You can’t compare an empty cell with an equals sign: there’s a separate way to ask whether a cell is empty.
textes.Quels festivaliers étaient mineurs le pr: Which festivalgoers were under 18 on the festival’s first day?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Festivalgoers sign up on the online box office with their date of birth, and minors have to show parental permission. Lucile, who runs the box office, is preparing her review. She lists the people signed up who weren’t 18 yet on the festival’s first day, meaning born after July 4, 2007: born that day, you were just 18.
textes.les festivaliers nés après le 4 juillet: the festivalgoers born after July 4, 2007, that day not included: born on July 4, 2007, you were just 18 on the first day
textes.Les dates écrites année-mois-jour se com: Dates written year-month-day compare directly. Keep those that come strictly after July 4, 2007.
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. The artists’ fees, the amount paid to each one to come and play, range from a few thousand euros to several tens of thousands for the headliners. Apolline, the director, is preparing the 2026 edition’s budget with the town hall. She starts with the 3 artists who cost the most in 2025.
textes.Trie les artistes du cachet le plus élev: Sort the artists from the highest fee to the lowest, then keep the first 3 rows. Fees not set yet come last.
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Its volunteers work in shifts, from setup on Thursday, July 3 to teardown on Monday, July 7. Moussa, who coordinates them, keeps the site attendance log. He wants to know who came to help with setup, the day before the festival, in which role and at what times.
textes.les créneaux du jeudi 3 juillet 2025, jo: the shifts on Thursday, July 3, 2025, setup day
textes.par heure de début, puis par nom: by start time, then by last name
textes.Le nom du bénévole est rangé avec les bé: The volunteer’s name is stored with the volunteers, the day with the shifts: link the two. Then keep setup day, written year-month-day.
textes.Quels concerts ont fini après le couvre-: Which concerts ended after the 11 p.m. curfew?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. The concerts follow one another from the afternoon until late at night, and some were cancelled. Iris, the production manager, got permission from the town hall to play after 11 p.m., the noise curfew. In return, she has to report every concert played that ended later, with its day and end time; ending at 11 p.m. sharp is allowed.

textes.les concerts qui ont fini après 23:00, s: the concerts that ended after 23:00, without those that ended at 23:00 sharp
textes.par jour, puis par heure de fin: by day, then by end time
textes.Relie chaque concert à son artiste pour: Link each concert to its artist to get their name. Two conditions true at the same time: the concert was played, and its end time, written as text, comes strictly after “23:00”.
textes.De quelles villes viennent les festivali: Which cities do the festivalgoers come from?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each festivalgoer signed up on the online box office gives their city, whether or not they bought a ticket. For the 2026 edition, Iris, the production manager, wants to organize shuttle buses from her festivalgoers’ cities. She needs the list of these cities, each written only once.
textes.la ville (une ligne par ville, sans doub: the city (one row per city, without duplicates)
textes.tous les festivaliers inscrits, qu’ils a: every festivalgoer signed up, whether or not they bought a ticket
textes.Plusieurs festivaliers habitent la même: Several festivalgoers live in the same city: ask to show each value only once, then sort the list.

textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Its online box office sells two pass types: the 1-day pass and the 3-day pass, the flagship option. Lucile, who runs the box office, is preparing the 2025 edition review. She starts with the 3-day pass and wants to know how many she sold online, and for what revenue.
textes.leur recette : la somme de leurs prix, e: their revenue: the sum of their prices, in euros
textes.les billets de formule « Pass 3 jours »: the tickets with the pass type “3-day pass”
textes.Garde les billets de la formule « Pass 3: Keep the tickets with the pass type “3-day pass”, written exactly like that. Then calculate two results side by side: their number, and the sum of their prices.
textes.Qui a reçu un billet acheté en décembre: Who got a ticket bought in December 2024?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. For each ticket bought online, its purchase date and its holder, the person who will use it, are known. For Christmas, the festival offered its tickets as gifts, with a card to slip under the tree. Apolline, the director, wants to write to the festivalgoers who received them: the holders of the tickets bought in December 2024.
textes.les billets achetés entre le 1er et le 3: the tickets bought between December 1 and 31, 2024, both days included
textes.Relie chaque billet à son titulaire pour: Link each ticket to its holder to get their name and email. Keep the December 2024 purchase dates: a date function shortens a date to its month.
textes.Quels noms d’artistes sont trop longs po: Which artist names are too long for a single line?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Twenty-three artists and bands are booked, with stage names that are sometimes long. Éliott, the programmer, is having the souvenir program printed, where each artist’s name is written very large. Beyond 15 characters, a name no longer fits on one line: he wants to spot these names, with their length, so the designer can adjust them.
textes.son nombre de caractères, espaces et sig: its number of characters, spaces and symbols included
textes.les noms de plus de 15 caractères, sans: the names longer than 15 characters, without those of exactly 15 characters
textes.par nombre de caractères, du plus grand: by number of characters, largest first, then by name
textes.Une fonction donne le nombre de caractèr: A function gives the number of characters in a text, spaces included. Use it twice: to keep the names longer than 15 characters, and to show their length.
textes.Que faut-il écrire sur l’invitation de c: What should be written on each volunteer’s invitation?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each volunteer signs up for a role, from the welcome desk to the bar, but some didn’t end up working any shift. After teardown, Moussa, who coordinates the volunteers, invites everyone signed up to the review meeting, even those who couldn’t come. He wants to prepare the text of each invitation: the first name followed by the last name in capitals, like “Thibault MERCIER”, then the role.
textes.dans une seule colonne, le prénom puis l: in a single column, the first name then the last name in capitals, separated by a space, for example “Thibault MERCIER”
textes.tous les bénévoles inscrits, y compris c: every volunteer signed up, including those who worked no shift
textes.Combien de créneaux chaque bénévole a-t-: How many shifts did each volunteer work?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each volunteer works shifts, from setup on July 3 to teardown on July 7, or none. Moussa, who coordinates the volunteers, is preparing the end-of-edition thank-yous. He counts the shifts each volunteer worked, setup and teardown included, without forgetting those who worked none.
textes.son nombre de créneaux, 0 s’il n’en a au: their number of shifts, 0 if they have none
textes.tous les bénévoles, y compris ceux qui n: every volunteer, including those with no shift
textes.par nombre de créneaux, du plus grand au: by number of shifts, largest first, then by last name
textes.Les créneaux du montage (3 juillet) et d: Setup (July 3) and teardown (July 7) shifts count too.
textes.Pars de tous les bénévoles, même sans cr: Start from every volunteer, even without a shift, then count their shifts. Counting the rows would give 1 to a volunteer without a shift: count the shifts actually found instead.
textes.Combien de minutes chaque artiste a-t-il: How many minutes did each artist play?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. An artist can play several concerts, each with its start time and end time, and some concerts were cancelled. Éliott, the programmer, is checking that each artist played as long as their contract said. He adds up the duration of their concerts played: an artist booked twice adds up both concerts.
textes.son temps de scène : la somme des durées: their stage time: the sum of the durations of their concerts played, in minutes
textes.seulement les concerts au statut « Joué: only the concerts with the status “Played”
textes.seulement les artistes qui ont joué au m: only the artists who played at least one concert
textes.La durée d’un concert est son heure de f: A concert’s duration is its end time minus its start time: a concert from 21:30 to 23:00 lasts 90 minutes.
textes.Les heures sont du texte : une fonction: Times are text: a date function first has to turn them into seconds. That way, calculate each concert played’s duration in minutes, then add up per artist.
textes.Quels concerts ont rempli leur scène à a: Which concerts filled their stage to at least 90%?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each stage has its capacity, the maximum number of people it can hold: from 300 at The Clearing to 5,000 in front of the Main Stage. The production team estimates each concert’s audience. Iris, the production manager, is planning more security staff in front of very full stages for 2026. She’s looking for the concerts that filled at least 90% of their stage’s capacity.
textes.le taux de remplissage, en pourcentage,: the fill rate, as a percentage out of 100: audience × 100 ÷ stage capacity, calculated with the decimals then rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les concerts dont le taux de r: only the concerts whose fill rate reaches at least 90%, 90% included
textes.par taux de remplissage, du plus élevé a: by fill rate, highest first, then by day, then by concert start time
textes.Relie chaque concert à sa scène pour la: Link each concert to its stage for the capacity, and to its artist for their name. Calculate the rate with a decimal number in the calculation, otherwise the division loses its decimals, then keep those of at least 90.
textes.Combien la prévente a-t-elle rapporté ?: How much did the presale bring in?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Its tickets sell cheaper until February 28, 2025 included, during the presale, then at full price. Lucile, who runs the box office, wonders whether the presale should be extended. For each pass type, she compares the sales during the presale and after.
textes.la période d’achat (une ligne par périod: the purchase period (one row per period and per pass type): “Presale” for a ticket bought up to February 28, 2025 included, “Full price” for a ticket bought from March 1, 2025
textes.la recette : la somme de leurs prix, en: the revenue: the sum of their prices, in euros
textes.par période, « Plein tarif » avant « Pré: by period, “Full price” before “Presale”, then by pass type
textes.Range chaque billet dans sa période selo: File each ticket into its period based on its purchase date. Then make one group for each period and pass type pair, then count the tickets and add up their prices.
textes.Quels pass 1 jour ont servi un autre jou: Which 1-day passes were used on a day other than their own?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. A 1-day pass is only valid for the day chosen at purchase, and each ticket is scanned at the gates at each entry. Lucile, who runs the box office, suspects fraud: some 1-day passes may have gone through the gates on another day. She wants to know which ones, and who they belong to.
textes.le jour où il a été scanné aux portes: the day it was scanned at the gates
textes.les passages de billets « Pass 1 jour »: the entries of “1-day pass” tickets scanned on a day other than their valid day
textes.par jour du passage, puis par heure du p: by entry day, then by entry time
textes.Chaque passage mène à son billet, puis a: Each entry leads to its ticket, then to the festivalgoer who holds it. Keep the 1-day passes whose entry day differs from the ticket’s valid day.
textes.Quels concerts en plein air ont été joué: Which open-air concerts were played on a rainy day?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Three stages out of four are open-air; the fourth is under a big top. Each day’s weather records the rain that fell, in millimeters. Iris, the production manager, has the open-air stages’ equipment checked after every rainy day. For the insurer, she lists the concerts played outdoors on a day when it rained, with the rain that fell that day.
textes.la pluie tombée ce jour-là, en millimètr: the rain that fell that day, in millimeters
textes.seulement les jours où il a plu, c’est-à: only the days when it rained, meaning when the rain is above 0 mm
textes.par jour, puis par heure de début du con: by day, then by concert start time
textes.La météo d’un concert est celle de son j: A concert’s weather is its day’s: the `weather` table has one row per day.
textes.La météo n’est pas reliée aux concerts p: The weather isn’t linked to the concerts by an ID: link them by the day, found on both sides. Then keep the concerts played, open-air, on a day when the rain is above 0.
textes.Qui a acheté son billet dès l’ouverture: Who bought their ticket as soon as the box office opened?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Its online box office opened in November 2024, and each ticket’s purchase date is known. To launch the 2026 sales, Apolline, the director, wants to give a t-shirt to the quickest festivalgoers of 2025: those who bought a ticket on the very first day of sales.
textes.la formule du billet acheté ce jour-là: the pass type of the ticket bought that day
textes.les billets achetés le premier jour de v: the tickets bought on the first day of sales: the oldest purchase date in the tickets table
textes.Calcule d’abord, à part, la date d’achat: First calculate, separately, the oldest purchase date, then keep that day’s tickets. Then link them to their holder.
textes.Quel budget prévoir pour chaque genre mu: What budget should be planned for each music genre?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each artist gets a fee for the whole edition, the amount paid to come and play. After the cancelled concerts, some fees are still being renegotiated: the cell stays empty. Apolline, the director, is presenting the artistic budget to the town hall. She counts €2,000 for each fee not set yet, and wants the total budget of each music genre.
textes.son budget : la somme des cachets de ses: its budget: the sum of its artists’ fees, in euros, counting €2,000 for each fee not set yet (NULL)
textes.tous les artistes, y compris ceux dont l: every artist, including those whose only concert was cancelled
textes.Le cachet d’un artiste couvre toute l’éd: An artist’s fee covers the whole edition: it counts only once, even if the artist played several times.
textes.Une fonction remplace une case vide par: A function replaces an empty cell with the value of your choice, here 2000: apply it before adding up. Make one group per genre, then count the artists and add up the fees.
textes.À quelles heures les portes ont-elles ét: At what times were the gates busiest?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each ticket is scanned at the North gate or the South gate, at each entry, with the day and time. Moussa, who coordinates the volunteers, places the welcome team at the gates. For 2026, he wants to spot the hours when entries piled up, at least 5 in the hour, to send extra help there.
textes.le jour (une ligne par jour et par heure: the day (one row per day and per hour)
textes.l’heure pleine des passages, sur deux ch: the whole hour of the entries, in two digits: “18” for entries from 18:00 to 18:59
textes.le nombre de passages pendant cette heur: the number of entries during that hour, all gates combined
textes.seulement les heures qui comptent au moi: only the hours with at least 5 entries
textes.Chaque passage compte, même celui d’un f: Each entry counts, even that of a festivalgoer who comes back a second time.
textes.Extrais l’heure pleine de chaque passage: Extract the whole hour of each entry and make one group for each day and hour pair. The condition applies to the number of entries: it applies once the counting is done.
textes.Combien de pass de chaque formule ont ét: How many passes of each type were scanned each day?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each ticket is scanned at the gates at each entry: a festivalgoer who leaves and comes back is scanned a second time. Éliott, the programmer, is comparing the 3-day pass crowd with the 1-day pass crowd. Day by day, he wants the total number of entries at the gates, then the number of different tickets scanned for each pass type.
textes.son nombre de passages aux portes, toute: its number of entries at the gates, all pass types combined
textes.son nombre de billets « Pass 3 jours » d: its number of different “3-day pass” tickets scanned
textes.son nombre de billets « Pass 1 jour » di: its number of different “1-day pass” tickets scanned
textes.Un pass 1 jour scanné un autre jour que: A 1-day pass scanned on a day other than its own still counts, on the day of its entry.

textes.Quels concerts des deux grandes scènes s: Which concerts on the two big stages overlap?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. The Main Stage and the Willow Stage, the two biggest, were supposed to take turns, never playing over each other. Iris, the production manager, got complaints. She’s looking for the concerts played on these two stages that overlapped, and for how many minutes.
textes.le nom de l’artiste de la Grande Scène: the name of the Main Stage artist
textes.le nom de l’artiste de la Scène des Saul: the name of the Willow Stage artist
textes.la durée du chevauchement, en minutes :: the length of the overlap, in minutes: from the later of the two start times to the earlier of the two end times
textes.les paires d’un concert de la Grande Scè: the pairs of a Main Stage concert and a Willow Stage concert, on the same day, whose times overlap
textes.seulement les concerts au statut « Joué: only the concerts with the status “Played”: a cancelled concert didn’t overlap any other
textes.par jour, puis par heure de début du con: by day, then by the Main Stage concert’s start time
textes.Deux concerts se chevauchent quand chacu: Two concerts overlap when each starts before the other ends: a concert that starts at the exact time the other ends doesn’t overlap it.
textes.Associe chaque concert de la Grande Scèn: Match each Main Stage concert with the Willow Stage ones on the same day. They overlap when each starts before the other ends; the overlap goes from the later start to the earlier end.
textes.Quels artistes forment le podium des spe: Which artists make up the audience podium?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. An artist can play several concerts, and each concert played counts its audience. Apolline, the director, is preparing the 2026 poster. She wants to feature the 2025 podium on it: the artists who drew the biggest audience across all their concerts, ties included.
textes.son total de spectateurs : la somme des: their total audience: the sum of their concerts’ audiences
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus grand total, l: their rank: 1 for the biggest total, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.seulement les artistes classés aux rangs: only the artists ranked 1 to 3, ties included
textes.par rang, puis par nom de l’artiste: by rank, then by artist name
textes.Un artiste qui a joué deux fois addition: An artist who played twice adds up the audiences of both concerts; a cancelled concert has no audience.
textes.Calcule le total de spectateurs de chaqu: Calculate each artist’s total audience, then their rank, with ties sharing their rank. The rank can only be filtered after it’s been calculated; cutting to 3 rows would lose the ties.
textes.Quel artiste a ouvert chaque scène, chaq: Which artist opened each stage, each day?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Four stages, from the Main Stage to The Clearing, host several concerts every day, from the afternoon into the night. Éliott, the programmer, is writing the edition’s souvenir book. He gives a page to each artist who opened a stage, meaning who played there first, day after day; a cancelled concert didn’t open anything.
textes.le nom de l’artiste qui l’a ouverte ce j: the name of the artist who opened it that day
textes.pour chaque jour et chaque scène, seulem: for each day and each stage, only the first concert played: a cancelled concert didn’t open the stage
textes.par jour, puis par heure de début: by day, then by start time
textes.Garde les concerts joués. Numérote-les d: Keep the concerts played. Number them from earliest to latest, with the numbering starting again at 1 for each day and each stage, then keep only the number 1s.
textes.Comment la recette a-t-elle grimpé, mois: How did revenue climb, month after month?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Its online box office opened in fall 2024 and sold tickets right up to the festival. Lucile, who runs the box office, is preparing the opening of the 2026 sales. She wants to review the 2025 curve: each month’s revenue since the opening, and the total revenue built up.
textes.le mois d’achat, au format AAAA-MM, par: the purchase month, in YYYY-MM format, for example “2024-11” (one row per month)
textes.le nombre de billets achetés ce mois-là: the number of tickets bought that month
textes.la recette du mois : la somme des prix d: the month’s revenue: the sum of these tickets’ prices, in euros
textes.la recette cumulée : la recette de ce mo: the running revenue: this month’s revenue added to that of all the previous months
textes.Calcule d’abord la recette de chaque moi: First calculate each month’s revenue, by extracting the month from the purchase date. Then add up these revenues as you go, in month order.
textes.Quels bénévoles ont enchaîné deux crénea: Which volunteers worked two shifts back to back without a real break?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. A volunteer can work several shifts on the same day, at the bar, the welcome desk, cleaning or security. Moussa, who coordinates the volunteers, wants everyone to have at least an hour’s break between two shifts on the same day. He’s rereading the edition’s schedule to spot the shifts that are too close together.
textes.l’heure de fin de son créneau précédent: the end time of their previous shift
textes.l’heure de début du créneau qui suit: the start time of the next shift
textes.la pause entre les deux, en minutes: the break between the two, in minutes
textes.seulement les pauses de moins de 60 minu: only the breaks of less than 60 minutes
textes.par jour, puis par heure de début du cré: by day, then by the next shift’s start time
textes.Le créneau précédent est celui du même b: The previous shift is the same volunteer’s, on the same day, that starts just before; a day’s first shift doesn’t have one.
textes.Pour chaque créneau, lis l’heure de fin: For each shift, read the end time of the same volunteer’s shift just before, on the same day: a function looks at the previous row. Calculate it separately, then keep the breaks of less than 60 minutes, turning the times into seconds.
textes.Comment se classent les cachets dans cha: How do the fees rank within each genre?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each artist belongs to a music genre, from chanson to techno, and has a fee, when it’s set. Éliott, the programmer, is preparing the 2026 negotiations. In each genre, he ranks the artists by fee, putting equal fees on the same level, without leaving a gap in the ranking.
textes.son niveau dans le genre : 1 pour le cac: their level in the genre: 1 for the highest fee; equal fees share the same level and the next one doesn’t skip (1, 1, 2)
textes.seulement les artistes dont le cachet es: only the artists whose fee is set, meaning not empty
textes.par genre, puis par niveau, puis par nom: by genre, then by level, then by artist name
textes.Le classement recommence à 1 dans chaque: The ranking starts again at 1 in each genre.
textes.Garde les cachets fixés. Classe les arti: Keep the fees that are set. Rank the artists from the highest fee to the lowest, with the ranking starting again at 1 for each genre, without leaving a gap after ties.
textes.Quels concerts ont attiré plus de monde: Which concerts drew more people than their stage’s average?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each stage draws its crowd, and each concert played counts its audience; a cancelled concert has none. Iris, the production manager, is preparing the 2026 safety plan. On each stage, she spots the concerts that drew a bigger audience than the average of that stage’s concerts played, to plan more water points there.
textes.la moyenne des spectateurs des concerts: the average audience of the concerts played on this stage, rounded to the nearest whole number
textes.seulement les concerts joués dont le nom: only the concerts played whose audience is strictly above their stage’s average
textes.par nom de la scène, puis par nombre de: by stage name, then by audience, largest first, then by artist name
textes.La moyenne d’une scène se calcule sur se: A stage’s average is calculated over its concerts played: a cancelled concert has no audience and doesn’t count.
textes.Compare le nombre de spectateurs à la mo: Compare the audience with the exact average, before rounding it.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate the average audience of each stage’s concerts played, then compare each concert played with its stage’s average, before rounding.
textes.Quelle part des billets valables a servi: What share of the valid tickets was used each day?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. A 3-day pass is valid for all three days of concerts, a 1-day pass only for the day chosen. Lucile, who runs the box office, is calculating each day’s attendance rate: among the tickets valid that day, what share was actually scanned at the gates that day? She’ll follow up with the no-shows for 2026.
textes.le jour de concerts (une ligne par jour,: the concert day (one row per day, from July 4 to 6, 2025)
textes.le nombre de billets valables ce jour-là: the number of tickets valid that day: all the 3-day passes, plus that day’s 1-day passes
textes.le nombre de ces billets valables scanné: the number of these valid tickets scanned at least once that day
textes.le taux de présence, en pourcentage, sur: the attendance rate, as a percentage out of 100: valid tickets scanned × 100 ÷ valid tickets, rounded to one decimal place
textes.Un pass 1 jour scanné un autre jour que: A 1-day pass scanned on a day other than its own isn’t valid that day: it counts neither among that day’s valid tickets nor among its scanned tickets.
textes.Dresse d’abord la liste des billets vala: First draw up the list of each day’s valid tickets: all the 3-day passes, plus that day’s 1-day passes. Then look for their entries that same day, keeping the tickets never scanned, and count the different tickets.
textes.Quels bénévoles ont travaillé plus que l: Which volunteers worked more than their team lead?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Each volunteer team has a lead, a volunteer too, and each work shift has its start and end times. Moussa, who coordinates the volunteers, is spotting those who worked more hours than their own lead, setup and teardown included. He’ll offer them to lead a team in 2026.
textes.son total d’heures : la somme des durées: their total hours: the sum of their shift durations, in hours
textes.son responsable : dans une seule colonne: their lead: in a single column, first name then last name separated by a space, for example “Thibault Mercier”
textes.le total d’heures du responsable, calcul: the lead’s total hours, calculated the same way
textes.seulement les bénévoles qui ont un respo: only the volunteers who have a lead
textes.seulement ceux dont le total d’heures dé: only those whose total hours are strictly above their lead’s
textes.par total d’heures du bénévole, du plus: by the volunteer’s total hours, largest first
textes.Tous les créneaux comptent, montage et d: Every shift counts, setup and teardown included: a shift from 14:00 to 18:00 lasts 4 hours.
textes.Calcule d’abord le total d’heures de cha: First calculate each volunteer’s total hours. Then match these totals with themselves: once for the volunteer, once for their lead, and compare the two.
textes.Quels bénévoles ont travaillé chacun des: Which volunteers worked each of the three concert days?
textes.Le festival des Hautes Herbes est un fes: The Hautes Herbes festival is an open-air music festival, from Friday, July 4 to Sunday, July 6, 2025. Its volunteers work from setup on July 3 to teardown on July 7. Apolline, the director, wants to give a 2026 pass to the most present volunteers: those who worked at least one shift on each of the three concert days. A setup or teardown shift doesn’t make up for a missed concert day.
textes.seulement les bénévoles qui ont au moins: only the volunteers with at least one shift on July 4, 5 and 6, 2025, each of these three days
textes.Un créneau de montage (3 juillet) ou de: A setup (July 3) or teardown (July 7) shift doesn’t make up for a missed concert day.
textes.Retourne la question : un bénévole convi: Turn the question around: a volunteer fits if there’s no concert day when they have no shift. This double negative becomes two checks for absence, one inside the other.
